values.note: recreation.gov's notice says 9 campsites and 1 group site; its description says 11 sites plus 1 group site. All back-in only, taking RVs 27 to 35 ft depending on the site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10172175 (notice 'Cascade Campground has 9 campsites and 1 group site.'; description 'Cascade Campground has 11 sites plus 1 group site that are back in only and can accommodate RV's 27' to 35' in length depending on the site'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cascade-campground (Seasons of Use: 'Open May 7, 2026- September 21, 2026.'; Current Conditions 'Closes 9/21/2026.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 2 vault toilets, drinking water from a hand-pump well for much of the season, trash service, paved roads and sites; primitive boat ramp on the Clark Fork across the highway.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10172175 ('The campground is paved with 2 vault toilets ... Trash service is available and drinking water is on site'; amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Paved Roads', 'Paved Sites') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cascade-campground ('Potable water is available at this site. Hand-pump well for much of the season.'; 'A primitive boat ramp is available on Clark Fork River across the highway'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: First come, first served at a self-serve fee station with no host on site; recreation.gov Scan & Pay is available (needs a Recreation.gov account).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10172175 ('This is a first come first served campground with a self-serve fee station with no host on site'; notice 'The maximum stay limit is 16 days per reservation.'; rules scanAndPay) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cascade-campground ('Scan & Pay option available, but you must have a Recreation.gov account.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $15 a single site (2 vehicles included), $5 each additional vehicle; group site $20.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/lolo/recreation/cascade-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night (2 vehicles included per site) Group Site: $20 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10172175/rates (2026 Peak Season PeakStandard 15, PeakGroup 20), read 2026-10-22

note: Lolo National Forest (Plains/Thompson Falls RD) campground in the Clark Fork canyon bottom on Hwy 135, ~18 mi northeast of St. Regis and 13 mi from groceries in Plains (distinct from Custer Gallatin's Cascade CG near Red Lodge). Beside the highway, across the road from the river; shaded by Douglas-fir, ponderosa pine and larch. Iron Mountain Trail #242 (historic wagon road) ends in the campground. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page and recreation.gov: confirmed FCFS, back-in only, RVs to 35 ft, vault toilets, potable water, $15/night, no hookups. Added season 05-07 to 09-21 (2026 dates), 16-night stay limit, Scan & Pay, fee and facility notes. Site count left at 10 (rec.gov notice 9 + 1 group; its description says 11 + 1). Note trimmed.
